children.text: Participants
ThinkByte: Mukul M, Harsha Thota, Samarpith Rout, Charan Kumar, Pavan Kalyan, Revanth Raavi
Sigmainfo: Magesh R, Sonam Dahake, Sandeep Phophaliya, to: Shiresha Madhury
Key Takeaways
A strategy for keyword targeting was emphasized by creating and using custom rejects to monitor search rankings.
The keyword tool’s geo-targeting capability was clarified, highlighting its role in generating regional content ideas while manual optimization remains essential.
Access to the content generation tool was requested for Martin to enable his direct involvement in producing the blogs.
An audit of paid ads campaigns for Lendfoundry and Sigma Services was proposed to address current challenges with generating quality leads.
A critical focus was placed on converting SEO efforts into predictable lead generation, with suggestions to share a lead plan and consider competitor benchmarking.

Review Google Ads performance for Lendfoundry and Sigma to optimize ad spend.
Achieve predictable lead generation for Sigma services through improved SEO strategy.
Current Workflow

GA4 only tracks post-landing traffic, missing AI search query data.
Integrate blogs with keyword research by cross-referencing landing page primary and secondary keywords.

GA4 limitations noted with regard to capturing AI search query data.
Positive Moments
Positive remarks were made regarding communication and timely turnarounds.
Team recognized effective directional inputs and contextual insights during the discussion.

Cornerstone blog is scheduled to go live tomorrow.
Blog images to be updated by end of day today.
Lead generation plan to be shared within this week.
Risk
Past Google Ads campaigns incurred wasted spend due to low-quality, junk leads.
Unpredictability of SEO lead generation poses a risk for meeting target lead volumes.
AI Search Visibility
787 AI search impressions recorded over 3 months from long-tail queries yield zero clicks but improve brand visibility.
Technology Stack Insights
GA4 limitations: It doesn’t capture AI search query data since tracking begins only after landing on the website.
Custom rejects matching in Google Search Console filters long-tail AI queries for enhanced brand visibility.
Keyword research platform integrates Google Keyword Planner, SEMrush, and geo-targeted analysis for actionable keyword insights.
SEO Strategy Alignment
Keyword and cluster analysis is cross-referenced with landing page targets for improved SEO.
Align blog content with keyword research across 9 verticals that support corresponding landing pages.
Content Development Schedule
Cornerstone blog to go live tomorrow with images updated by EOD.
Blogs on Salesforce, banking app, digital lending, AI chatbot, and reacts.net are prepared from last month with pending image updates.
Google Ads Performance Review
Past Google Ads campaigns underperformed, generating low-quality leads particularly from India.
A review of historical Google Ads data is recommended to identify actionable improvements.
